typed: Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming

expect: one reply, no duplicate bubbles, sensible tone and casing
lastReply:
Aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/Ultra 5 chip, which is plenty for programming at ₹80,000.

RAM: 16 GB is the real minimum. 8 GB struggles with an editor, browser and virtual machines open together. Pick one with a free slot or upgradable RAM if you can.
Storage: 512 GB SSD or more.
Screen: Full HD IPS, 14 to 15.6 inch, bright enough for daytime use.
Keyboard and battery: You'll type all day, so a good keyboard and 8+ hours of battery matter more than a flashy design.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you do AI work or games. It adds weight and cost for nothing in everyday coding.
Mac option: An M-series MacBook Air can come close to this budget in sales, and its battery life is excellent.

What will you mostly build: web and apps, or AI and games? That decides whether a graphics card is worth it.
